dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Multiple irregular 'O' and 'C' shaped annular structures on the dorsal surface show high-contrast light perimeters transitioning sharply to darker interior regions.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: High-intensity pixel clusters are concentrated in the mid-dorsal region, forming the perimeters of the macro-annuli. Density is lower on the lateral flanks.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the three most prominent 'O' shaped annuli on the upper-left dorsal quadrant form an obtuse scalene triangle.

other_distinctive_markers: A prominent light-colored longitudinal ridge or fold is visible along the dorsal surface of the muzzle.
